name: VLF Radio
description: The soundcard IS the radio: a coil on line-in receives the basement of the spectrum. Full-band SDR spectrum + waterfall with click-to-tune, CW/USB/LSB/AM demodulation at selectable bandwidth, a mains-hum comb filter, and a station guide from Alpha and the MSK giants to SAQ Grimeton and the 60/77.5 kHz time stations (192 k soundcards reach them). TX side keys carrier, CW and QRSS for magnetic-induction experiments — across the room barefoot, farther with an amp and a serious loop.
author: Ham Radio Web Studio
